summary.intent: Resolve the merge conflict on PR #299 (branch feat/factory-results) against main so it can be merged, while keeping commits signed and checks clean.
summary.outcome: Merged main into the branch with no textual conflicts, regenerated the golden cache snapshot in a separate signed commit (56cbcf54), and pushed; GitHub now shows #299 as MERGEABLE with status BLOCKED, likely pending checks (not confirmed). All 1067 workspace tests pass and lint, doc-check, typos and machete are clean locally.

repo: GitHub can report a PR as conflicting even when `git merge main` has no textual conflicts, because of history from earlier stacked merges; pushing a merge commit of main resolved it.

The golden cache snapshot test is sensitive to schema and fixture changes: #293 added a `typeof` binding to the golden fixture while this branch bumped the schema to 28, so the snapshot bytes differed after merging and needed regeneration.
Pre-merge checks for this repo include lint, doc-check, typos and machete, and commits are expected to be signed.
CLI config tests fail in a fresh worktree until `pnpm install` is run.
workflow: Regenerate snapshots in a separate signed commit from the merge commit to keep history clear.
Use a temporary git worktree for the merge and remove it afterward.
A MERGEABLE/BLOCKED status right after a push likely means checks are still running; verify before assuming a real problem.

friction: GitHub reported a conflict that git could not reproduce locally.
Golden snapshot test failed on the merged tree because two independent changes (#293 fixture and the schema 28 bump) interacted.
CLI config tests failed initially because the fresh worktree lacked installed dependencies.
open_items: Merge #299 once its checks are green; BLOCKED status was not confirmed to be only pending checks.
Wave 1 tasks `t164-correct` and `t165-lints` are still in progress.
